reference_provenance.method: Manual semantic review of all 88 raw query/history records before comparison with implementation output. No prediction, gold, frozen or holdout data used. Provider mentions preserve textual order in the latest provider-bearing user turn. Assistant history never supplies customer facts.
reference_provenance.policy: Current provider requires explicit customer ownership/current service use, including observed requests linked to customer actions or credentials. Capability, pricing, hypothetical and comparison mentions do not establish current use. Cases needing a role/alias-policy decision are marked ambiguous and excluded from strict current-provider accuracy.
